messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH — inference-queue-backlog on cluster-inference-prod. queue_depth=42,100, avg_wait=3.2s, tail_99=8.7s. autoscaler: scale_loop_error=ThrottleQuotaExceeded. PD: https://pd.example/INC12345

pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident INC12345 created · triggered by metric rule 'inference.queue.backlog'. Escalation policy: oncall-sre.

maria: Ack. I'm oncall. paging eng-runtime and eng-sre. tagging: @jamie @raj. starting triage — pulling logs/metrics now.

jamie: seeing elevated 504 and 502 spikes on /v1/generate across regions us-west1/us-east1. error_rate ~6% last 5m, median latency 450ms but p95/p99 exploded. some requests timing out at the LB.

maria: autoscaler controller logs show repeated 429 from cloud provider and 'quota exceeded' errors. snippet:
```
2026-03-17T16:12:02Z controller.go:271 scale attempt failed: QuotaExceeded: cannot create nodes: InsufficientQuota
2026-03-17T16:12:07Z autoscaler.go:430 retrying in 30s
```

raj: I've opened a request with infra-quota (ticket Q-8812) to raise nodepool size; response ETA ~10-15m. will try a manual spin-up in the meantime.

maria: trying manual scale for inference deployment to buy headroom. running:
```bash
kubectl -n inference-prod scale deployment inference-cell --replicas=12
```
result: scheduling pending due to node provisioning failures (quota).

jamie: I can temporarily redirect ~30% of non-critical traffic to dedicated-reserved pool (dedicated-dev) to reduce pressure. flipping flag now.

oliver: CS: Notifying impacted customers (low-volume enterprise customers may see timeouts). drafting one-line status update for status.redwood.ai.

maria: PD: escalating to SRE lead in 5m if not stable. Also enabling degraded-mode: reduce max_concurrency to 8 for heavy routes to stabilize KV cache pressure.

jamie: feature-flag toggle done — routing applied to dedicated pool. seeing immediate drop in queue depth: 42,100 -> 27,400 in ~90s. error_rate trending down to 3.2%.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by maria.

maria: continuing to monitor. still waiting on infra-quota to confirm nodepool increase. if quota not available, we'll keep traffic split and consider shedding lowest-priority workloads.

raj: infra-quota replied: provisioning approved but node spin-up will take ~6m once started. kicking off nodepool expansion now.

maria: nodepool expansion in progress. k8s events show new nodes joining.

jamie: once nodes are ready, I'll scale inference-cell to target replicas and monitor KV cache warmup. plan: gradual +5 replicas every 60s to avoid cold-start storm.

oliver: update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased inference queue backlog affecting some customers; mitigation underway. Engineers actively routing traffic and adding capacity." linking PD.

pagerduty-bot: PD: INC12345 — escalated to SRE lead (esc_level=1).

maria: okay, new nodes are Ready. scaling to 18 replicas now.
```bash
kubectl -n inference-prod scale deployment inference-cell --replicas=18
```

jamie: replicas scheduling, traffic draining looks stable. queue_depth falling to 9,800 and latency p99 down to 1.9s. error_rate ~1.1%.

maria: consolidating notes for handoff. mitigation steps performed: manual scale attempted -> blocked by quota -> routed non-critical traffic to dedicated pool -> infra approved nodepool expansion -> scaled to 18 replicas -> monitoring stable.

oliver: CS update: customers notified; only small subset saw elevated timeouts. no data loss. support queue increased but manageable.

maria: prepping handoff to raj for follow-up/cleanup. planned actions for next shift: confirm autoscaler config and quota thresholds, add an automated retry/backoff for provider quota errors, and review routing fallback thresholds.

raj: ack takeover. I'll stay on for the next 40m to clean up feature flag and validate autoscale health. opening follow-up ticket SRE-INC-212 for root-cause and action items.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 — status: acknowledged, handlers: maria, raj.

maria: handing off. tagging runbook entries and adding timestamps for actions in the ticket. thanks team :thumbsup:
